policy.text: When carrying a pillion, follow the manual's guidelines for carrying a pillion, luggage or accessories.

watchouts.text: Do not load weight or install accessories incorrectly. This may affect the motorcycle's stability, handling and safe operation and could cause an accident resulting in serious injury or loss of life.
